For example, when the GPU memory can accommodate the history of A and B, let both proceed first while C waits; after A finishes, allow C to enter, which can reduce mutual eviction among the three. This example illustrates access granularity; the window in practical methods will adjust dynamically.

并发上限应覆盖任务跨轮积累的状态。只限制正在处理的请求数，仍可能让大量等待工具的.zh: 并发上限应覆盖任务跨轮积累的状态。只限制正在处理的请求数，仍可能让大量等待工具的任务轮流进入，造成缓存工作集过大。作者在 Qwen3-32B、DeepSeek-V3 的离线批量服务中报告整批完成时间下降，并通过命中率与占用曲线解释收益；固定窗口则容易在利用不足和缓存抖动之间失衡。
并发上限应覆盖任务跨轮积累的状态。只限制正在处理的请求数，仍可能让大量等待工具的.en: The concurrency limit should cover the state accumulated across task rounds. Only limiting the number of requests being processed may still allow many tasks waiting for tools to enter in turns, causing the cache working set to become too large. The authors report that batch completion time decreased in offline batch services with Qwen3-32B and DeepSeek-V3 and explain the benefits through hit rate and utilization curves; a fixed window easily becomes unbalanced between underutilization and cache jitter.

与 Continnum/MORI 决定已进入系统的状态如何保留相比，CONCUR.zh: 与 Continnum/MORI 决定已进入系统的状态如何保留相比，CONCUR 控制进入竞争的任务规模；与 EfficientAgent 的 CPU 缓存写入准入相比，它控制 Agent 执行准入。三者可以放在同一条因果链上理解：活跃任务数量与历史长度决定复用工作集，工作集和容量共同决定状态能否留到下次使用。研究不同长度、不同工具等待时间的任务混合时，需要先检查“按任务个数限流”是否能准确反映压力；这仍是待验证的问题。
与 Continnum/MORI 决定已进入系统的状态如何保留相比，CONCUR.en: Compared with Continnum/MORI deciding how to retain states that have entered the system, CONCUR controls the scale of tasks entering contention; compared with EfficientAgent's CPU cache write admission, it controls Agent execution admission. The three can be understood on the same causal chain: the number of active tasks and historical length determine the reuse working set, and the working set along with capacity determines whether a state can be retained for next use. When studying task mixes of different lengths and different tool wait times, one must first check whether 'task-count-based rate limiting' can accurately reflect pressure; this remains a question to be verified.

长程 Agent 每轮通常只新增少量内容，却要继续使用很长的历史。当历史 KV.zh: 长程 Agent 每轮通常只新增少量内容，却要继续使用很长的历史。当历史 KV 已存到外部存储，命中可以省掉重算，但仍要把 KV 读回来。在 Prefill/Decode 分离的集群里，原有路径集中使用 Prefill 机器的存储网卡，Decode 机器的存储网卡可能闲置，导致 GPU 等数据。
长程 Agent 每轮通常只新增少量内容，却要继续使用很长的历史。当历史 KV.en: Long-horizon agents usually add little content per turn while continuing to use a long history. When historical KV is stored externally, a cache hit avoids recomputation but still requires reading it back. In a cluster with disaggregated prefill and decode, the original data path concentrates storage traffic on prefill machines' network interfaces while those on decode machines may sit idle, leaving GPUs waiting for data.

连接计算机器与外部存储，.en: Connect the computing machine and external storage,

用于 GPU 所在机器之间的高速通信。论文利用计算网络相对充裕的带宽，增加第二条.zh: 用于 GPU 所在机器之间的高速通信。论文利用计算网络相对充裕的带宽，增加第二条读取路径：
用于 GPU 所在机器之间的高速通信。论文利用计算网络相对充裕的带宽，增加第二条.en: Used for high-speed communication between machines with GPUs. The paper utilizes the relatively abundant bandwidth of the compute network to add a second read path:

存储 → Prefill 机器的 CPU 内存 → 按层送入 Prefill G.zh: 存储 → Prefill 机器的 CPU 内存 → 按层送入 Prefill GPU；每层计算完成后，把命中与新增 token 的完整 KV 送到 Decode 机器的 CPU 缓冲区。
存储 → Prefill 机器的 CPU 内存 → 按层送入 Prefill G.en: Storage → Prefill machine’s CPU memory → layer-by-layer into Prefill GPU; after computing each layer, send the full KV of hits and new tokens to the Decode machine’s CPU buffer.

存储 → Decode 机器的 CPU 缓冲区 → 经 RDMA 按层送到 Pr.zh: 存储 → Decode 机器的 CPU 缓冲区 → 经 RDMA 按层送到 Prefill GPU；计算后只把新增 token 的 KV 传回，与 Decode 侧已有历史合并。
存储 → Decode 机器的 CPU 缓冲区 → 经 RDMA 按层送到 Pr.en: Storage → Decode machine's CPU buffer → sent layer by layer to Prefill GPU via RDMA; after computation, only the KV of new tokens is sent back and merged with the existing history on the Decode side.

两条路径都会在 prompt 的 KV 准备好后，将其装入 Decode GPU.zh: 两条路径都会在 prompt 的 KV 准备好后，将其装入 Decode GPU 开始生成。DE 路径中的 Decode 机器先承担读取与暂存，Prefill 计算仍由 Prefill GPU 完成。存储侧按跨全部层的块读写，Prefill 侧按单层块流式搬运，让传输与计算重叠，减少 Prefill 端显存占用。
两条路径都会在 prompt 的 KV 准备好后，将其装入 Decode GPU.en: Both paths will load the prompt's KV into the Decode GPU to start generation once it is ready. The Decode machine in the DE path first handles reading and buffering, while the Prefill computation is still done by the Prefill GPU. On the storage side, reads and writes are done in blocks across all layers, while on the Prefill side, single-layer blocks are moved in a streaming manner, allowing overlap between transfer and computation and reducing memory usage on the Prefill end.

新增路径要避免影响模型通信，因此还需要两个配套机制：.zh: 新增路径要避免影响模型通信，因此还需要两个配套机制：
新增路径要避免影响模型通信，因此还需要两个配套机制：.en: New paths must avoid affecting model communication, so two additional supporting mechanisms are also needed:

KV 在 CPU 与 GPU 之间的搬运也经过配对 CNIC，通过 RDMA（远.zh: KV 在 CPU 与 GPU 之间的搬运也经过配对 CNIC，通过 RDMA（远程直接内存访问）传输。这样本地搬运与跨机器传输都能受网卡的流量优先级控制。模型的专家通信、集合通信使用高优先级队列；KV 流量使用低优先级队列，利用空闲带宽并保留最低服务份额。绕行网卡增加了路径，但提供了普通 CUDA 拷贝难以实现的统一隔离。
KV 在 CPU 与 GPU 之间的搬运也经过配对 CNIC，通过 RDMA（远.en: KV transfer between CPU and GPU also goes through paired CNICs, transmitted via RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access). This allows both local transfer and cross-machine transmission to be controlled by NIC traffic priority. Model expert communication and collective communication use high-priority queues; KV traffic uses low-priority queues, utilizing idle bandwidth while reserving a minimal service share. Routing around the NIC adds a path but provides unified isolation that ordinary CUDA copies cannot achieve.

联合选择执行机器与读路径。.zh: 联合选择执行机器与读路径。
联合选择执行机器与读路径。.en: Jointly select the execution machine and read path.

调度器参考各引擎尚未处理完的 token、请求数量、Decode 剩余显存和节点.zh: 调度器参考各引擎尚未处理完的 token、请求数量、Decode 剩余显存和节点读取队列，平衡计算与 I/O。为请求选好 Prefill/Decode 引擎后，优先从读取队列较短的一侧加载 KV。当前实现为每个请求选择一条路径；把同一请求拆到两侧同时读是作者提出的后续工作。
调度器参考各引擎尚未处理完的 token、请求数量、Decode 剩余显存和节点.en: The scheduler references the tokens not yet processed by each engine, the number of requests, remaining Decode memory, and node read queues, balancing computation and I/O. After selecting the appropriate Prefill/Decode engine for a request, it prioritizes loading KV from the side with the shorter read queue. The current implementation chooses one path per request; splitting the same request to read from both sides simultaneously is proposed as future work by the author.

：根据已缓存长度和本轮新增 token，估计 attention 的运行时间。装.zh: ：根据已缓存长度和本轮新增 token，估计 attention 的运行时间。装入请求达到时间预算后停止，超预算请求切成更小的 chunk，减少不同 GPU 在同步点互相等待。相同新增 token 数对应的历史长度不同，attention 工作量也会不同，因此单纯平衡 token 数仍不够。
：根据已缓存长度和本轮新增 token，估计 attention 的运行时间。装.en: : Estimate the attention runtime based on the already cached length and the newly generated tokens in this round. Stop loading requests when the time budget is reached; requests that exceed the budget are split into smaller chunks to reduce waiting among different GPUs at synchronization points. The historical length corresponding to the same number of newly generated tokens may differ, so the attention workload may also vary; therefore, balancing token numbers alone is not sufficient.

高 KV 命中率会把一部分工作从重算转移到读取。此时性能可能受读取路径和网卡分配.zh: 高 KV 命中率会把一部分工作从重算转移到读取。此时性能可能受读取路径和网卡分配限制，扩大 Prefill 算力未必解决问题。DualPath 通过汇聚两侧存储带宽、隔离 KV 流量、平衡批次计算时间改善服务能力；上下文追加或生成变长、计算占比上升时，收益条件也会变化。
高 KV 命中率会把一部分工作从重算转移到读取。此时性能可能受读取路径和网卡分配.en: A high KV hit rate shifts some work from recomputation to reading. At this point, performance may be limited by the read path and network card allocation, and increasing Prefill compute resources may not necessarily solve the problem. DualPath improves service capability by aggregating storage bandwidth on both sides, isolating KV traffic, and balancing batch computation time; the conditions for benefit also change when adding context or generating variable-length sequences where computation takes up a larger proportion.

工具运行时，任务的 KV 暂时不用，却占据显存。系统希望把暂时不会返回的状态卸载.zh: 工具运行时，任务的 KV 暂时不用，却占据显存。系统希望把暂时不会返回的状态卸载，并在工具结束前恢复。工具名称、历史耗时和调用参数无法完整反映本次运行中的资源争用、下载速度和执行阶段。论文增加一条来自运行中工具的进度通道，持续修正这些决定。
工具运行时，任务的 KV 暂时不用，却占据显存。系统希望把暂时不会返回的状态卸载.en: During tool execution, the task's KV is temporarily unused but occupies GPU memory. The system aims to offload states that will not return temporarily and restore them before the tool finishes. The tool name, historical duration, and call parameters cannot fully reflect resource contention, download speed, and execution phase during this run. The paper adds a progress channel from the tool in execution, continuously refining these decisions.

When each stage takes uneven time, completion percentage cannot be directly treated as time percentage; this type of signal mainly helps trigger prefetching.

对 Agent 自己生成的脚本，可在生成时加入旁路进度行，并对原脚本与插桩脚本的.en: For scripts generated by the Agent itself, bypass progress lines can be added during generation, and the outputs and exit statuses of the original script and the instrumented script can be compared. This path requires additional generation and checking; it cannot be assumed that any script can be rewritten at no cost.

统一生成包含 call id、完成量、已知总量、阶段、时间戳的事件。总量失效时撤.zh: 统一生成包含 call id、完成量、已知总量、阶段、时间戳的事件。总量失效时撤回百分比，无法可靠解析的调用继续采用原有策略。
统一生成包含 call id、完成量、已知总量、阶段、时间戳的事件。总量失效时撤.en: Generate unified events containing call id, completion amount, known total, stage, and timestamp. When the total amount is invalid, withdraw by percentage; calls that cannot be reliably parsed continue to follow the original strategy.

仅有 GPU 时，信号帮助判断谁应留下；有 DRAM 卸载层时，还要决定何时卸载.zh: 仅有 GPU 时，信号帮助判断谁应留下；有 DRAM 卸载层时，还要决定何时卸载、何时取回。估计即将返回时优先保留；预计还要很久时放松保留，在返回前留出恢复预算。上下阈值使用迟滞，减少估计小幅波动导致的来回搬运。release 提供回收机会，最终仍受引擎的正常缓存管理约束。
仅有 GPU 时，信号帮助判断谁应留下；有 DRAM 卸载层时，还要决定何时卸载.en: When only GPU is available, signals help determine who should stay; when there is a DRAM offload layer, it is also necessary to decide when to offload and when to retrieve. Prefer retaining when it is estimated to return soon; relax retention when it is expected to take a long time, leaving room for recovery before returning. Upper and lower thresholds use hysteresis to reduce back-and-forth movements caused by slight fluctuations in estimates. Release provides an opportunity for recycling, but ultimately it is still subject to the engine's normal cache management constraints.

工具运行中的进度，能提供历史统计和引擎占用率看不到的信息。它的价值尤其体现在“是.zh: 工具运行中的进度，能提供历史统计和引擎占用率看不到的信息。它的价值尤其体现在“是否还来得及恢复”这一决策点；精确知道百分比仍不等于可以精确预测完成时间。长远程请求、未知脚本、非均匀阶段和环境突变都会限制信号效果。
工具运行中的进度，能提供历史统计和引擎占用率看不到的信息。它的价值尤其体现在“是.en: Progress during tool execution can provide information not visible in historical statistics and engine utilization. Its value is especially evident at the decision point of “whether there is still time to recover”; knowing the exact percentage does not equate to precisely predicting completion time. Long-distance requests, unknown scripts, uneven stages, and environmental changes all limit the effectiveness of the signal.

作者通过 mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、自行运行的 SWE-.zh: 作者通过 mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、自行运行的 SWE-bench Verified，以及扩展工具语料检查信号与开销；自身 Agent 使用 Qwen 3.8 Flash，并对其他开源/闭源模型作比较。系统层在 4×H100 上用 vLLM 做会话回放，分别测试 GPU-only 与 GPU＋DRAM，报告工具结束后的 p90 TTFT、吞吐、重载量改善。回放端的精确模型 checkpoint、vLLM 版本和完整公开复现入口未充分披露。插桩的任务分数对照用于检查干扰，不证明缓存控制提高了任务成功率。
作者通过 mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、自行运行的 SWE-.en: The authors checked signals and overhead using mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, SWE-bench Verified run independently, and extended tool corpora; their own agent uses Qwen 3.8 Flash and compares with other open-source/closed-source models. At the system level, sessions were replayed on 4×H100 using vLLM, testing GPU-only and GPU+DRAM configurations, reporting p90 TTFT, throughput, and reload improvements after the tool completes. The exact model checkpoint, vLLM version, and complete publicly reproducible entry for the replay side were not fully disclosed. Instrumented task scores were used for interference checks and do not prove that cache control improves task success rates.

进度报告还可能不准确或被伪造，论文提出会话信用预算作为保护，但相关评估只是初步模.zh: 进度报告还可能不准确或被伪造，论文提出会话信用预算作为保护，但相关评估只是初步模拟。对“历史预测完全无用”的宽泛判断也应谨慎：论文更直接支持的是，在所测长工具调用与环境变化下，运行中信号能补充甚至超过调用前估计。
进度报告还可能不准确或被伪造，论文提出会话信用预算作为保护，但相关评估只是初步模.en: Progress reports may also be inaccurate or falsified. The paper proposes a session credit budget as protection, but related evaluations are only preliminary simulations. Care should also be taken with broad judgments such as 'historical predictions are completely useless': the paper more directly supports that under the measured long tool calls and environmental changes, runtime signals can supplement or even surpass pre-call estimates.

Continnum 使用工具历史分布，昨天的 Copilot 研究预测轮间用户空.zh: Continnum 使用工具历史分布，昨天的 Copilot 研究预测轮间用户空闲；这里读取轮内工具的实时状态。值得讨论的是哪些工具信号足以覆盖真实 KV 恢复预算、缺失时如何回退。进度通道与保留策略已有具体工作覆盖，新题需要进一步定位到未解决的工具类型、负载或接口问题。
Continnum 使用工具历史分布，昨天的 Copilot 研究预测轮间用户空.en: Continnum uses the historical distribution of tools, and yesterday's Copilot study predicted user idleness between rounds; here it reads the real-time status of tools within a round. It is worth discussing which tool signals are sufficient to cover the actual KV recovery budget and how to fall back when missing. Progress channels and retention strategies are already covered by specific work; new issues need further identification for unresolved tool types, loads, or interface issues.

编排器知道当前轮次、工具依赖和 prompt 结构，引擎掌握模型计算与缓存。两者.zh: 编排器知道当前轮次、工具依赖和 prompt 结构，引擎掌握模型计算与缓存。两者只交换完整请求和完整结果时，部分本可并行的工作会被串行执行。Sutradhara 用一组薄接口传递这些信息，组合三项优化。
编排器知道当前轮次、工具依赖和 prompt 结构，引擎掌握模型计算与缓存。两者.en: The orchestrator knows the current round, tool dependencies, and prompt structure, while the engine handles model computation and caching. When the two only exchange complete requests and complete results, work that could partially be executed in parallel ends up being executed sequentially. Sutradhara passes this information through a set of thin interfaces, combining three optimizations.

一、工具执行与下一轮部分 prefill 重叠。.zh: 一、工具执行与下一轮部分 prefill 重叠。
一、工具执行与下一轮部分 prefill 重叠。.en: 1. Tool execution overlaps with the next round of partial prefill.

下一轮 prompt 中，工具输出之前的连续前缀往往已经确定。编排器先提交这段前.zh: 下一轮 prompt 中，工具输出之前的连续前缀往往已经确定。编排器先提交这段前缀，取得 continuation handle（续接句柄）；引擎在工具运行期间处理前缀并保留其 KV。工具返回后，编排器用句柄追加包含结果的后缀，再完成 prefill 和 decode。提前处理的必须是最终输入中不再改变的前缀；它利用因果 attention 的依赖结构，无需猜测工具结果。已有 KV 命中的部分继续复用，实际要提前做的工作取决于未缓存内容。工具失败或取消时需释放这份临时状态。
下一轮 prompt 中，工具输出之前的连续前缀往往已经确定。编排器先提交这段前.en: In the next round of prompts, the continuous prefix before the tool output is often already determined. The orchestrator first submits this prefix and obtains a continuation handle; the engine processes the prefix during tool execution and retains its KV. After the tool returns, the orchestrator uses the handle to append a suffix containing the results and then completes prefill and decode. The part that must be processed in advance is the prefix that will no longer change in the final input; it leverages the dependency structure of causal attention and does not need to predict tool results. The already hit KV parts continue to be reused, and the actual work to be done in advance depends on the uncached content. The temporary state must be released if the tool fails or is canceled.

二、decode 期间流式派发工具。.zh: 二、decode 期间流式派发工具。
二、decode 期间流式派发工具。.en: 2. Stream dispatching of tools during decode.

模型输出多个 JSON 工具调用时，编排器逐 token 解析。一个完整工具对象.zh: 模型输出多个 JSON 工具调用时，编排器逐 token 解析。一个完整工具对象的名称与参数确定后，就可以先派发它，同时模型继续生成后续调用；下一轮仍等待所需工具完成。这依赖工具调用可独立提交及执行依赖已明确，不能把尚未完整生成的参数当作可执行调用。
模型输出多个 JSON 工具调用时，编排器逐 token 解析。一个完整工具对象.en: When the model outputs multiple JSON tool calls, the orchestrator parses token by token. Once the name and parameters of a complete tool object are determined, it can be dispatched first while the model continues to generate subsequent calls; the next round still waits for the required tool to complete. This relies on tool calls being independently submitted and the dependencies already being clear; incomplete parameters cannot be treated as executable calls.

三、给 KV 标注复用角色。.zh: 三、给 KV 标注复用角色。
三、给 KV 标注复用角色。.en: 3. Assign roles for KV annotation reuse.

编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，.zh: 编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，引擎结合类别设置驱逐优先级，同级使用 LRU。本文策略优先回收最终回答、再到工具输出与用户查询，较晚回收系统提示，优先保护等待续接的部分 prefill。最终回答低复用是本文工作流的假设；多轮聊天中它可能进入下一轮历史，不能直接照搬固定排序。调度同时保留整个 Agent 请求的到达顺序。
编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，.en: The orchestrator marks categories such as system prompts, user queries, tool results, final answers, and partial prefill, and the engine sets eviction priorities according to the categories, using LRU for items of the same level. The strategy in this article prioritizes reclaiming final answers, then tool outputs and user queries, while reclaiming system prompts later and giving priority protection to partial prefill waiting for continuation. The assumption of low reuse of final answers is the workflow of this article; in multi-turn chats, they may enter the next round's history and the fixed order cannot be directly applied. Scheduling also preserves the arrival order of the entire Agent request.

提升一次 Agent 请求的速度，可以来自缩短其依赖链上的串行等待，而无需改变模.zh: 提升一次 Agent 请求的速度，可以来自缩短其依赖链上的串行等待，而无需改变模型参数。prompt splitting、流式工具派发和缓存提示相互配合；提前计算也会占 GPU 与显存，收益取决于工具时延、可提前处理的前缀和并发压力。
提升一次 Agent 请求的速度，可以来自缩短其依赖链上的串行等待，而无需改变模.en: Speeding up an Agent request can come from shortening the serial wait on its dependency chain without changing model parameters. Prompt splitting, streaming tool dispatch, and cached prompts work together; pre-computation also occupies GPU and memory, and the benefits depend on tool latency, prefixes that can be pre-processed, and concurrency pressure.

实现基于 vLLM 0.11.0，主模型 Qwen3-14B、BF16、A100.zh: 实现基于 vLLM 0.11.0，主模型 Qwen3-14B、BF16、A100-80GB，另有 Gemma 27B 泛化实验。评测使用生产子集和 BFCL v4 Web Search、SWE-bench 轨迹回放，部分工具时延按原比例归一化；不能据此认定提高了真实闭环任务成功率。公开轨迹实验为追加式历史，生产模板可能改变前缀。具体模型 checkpoint 修订、完整生产数据与可复现代码状态仍需核实。
实现基于 vLLM 0.11.0，主模型 Qwen3-14B、BF16、A100.en: Implemented based on vLLM 0.11.0, the main model is Qwen3-14B, BF16, A100-80GB, with additional Gemma 27B generalized experiments. Evaluation uses production subsets and BFCL v4 Web Search, SWE-bench trace replay, with some tool latencies normalized according to original proportions; this cannot be taken as evidence of improved real closed-loop task success rate. Public trace experiments use additive history; production templates may change the prefix. Specific model checkpoint revisions, complete production data, and reproducible code status still need to be verified.

指从用户请求到最终回答第一个可见 token，包含此前模型—工具多轮执行；它与某.zh: 指从用户请求到最终回答第一个可见 token，包含此前模型—工具多轮执行；它与某一次内部 LLM 调用的 TTFT 计时范围不同。论文用 FTR、端到端延迟、承载请求率及缓存行为评价系统。
指从用户请求到最终回答第一个可见 token，包含此前模型—工具多轮执行；它与某.en: Refers to the time from the user request to the first visible token of the final answer, including the prior multi-turn model-tool execution; it differs from the TTFT timing range of a single internal LLM call. Papers evaluate the system using FTR, end-to-end latency, request throughput, and cache behavior.

与 Ask the Tool 的实时进度相比，这里主要共享已知的结构信息：哪些输.zh: 与 Ask the Tool 的实时进度相比，这里主要共享已知的结构信息：哪些输入已确定、哪些工具调用已完整生成、哪些状态马上会用。进一步研究应先测这些信息在实际 Qwen/DeepSeek 工作流中能暴露多少并行机会，以及提前计算对其他请求带来多少竞争。
与 Ask the Tool 的实时进度相比，这里主要共享已知的结构信息：哪些输.en: Compared to the real-time progress of Ask the Tool, this mainly shares known structural information: which inputs are fixed, which tool calls are fully generated, and which states will be used soon. Further research should first measure how much parallelism this information can expose in actual Qwen/DeepSeek workflows and how much competition precomputation introduces for other requests.

长程任务会积累错误。这里分别研究当前理解是否一致、训练是否适应执行过程、环境怎样.zh: 长程任务会积累错误。这里分别研究当前理解是否一致、训练是否适应执行过程、环境怎样回退，以及第一次错误在哪里。
长程任务会积累错误。这里分别研究当前理解是否一致、训练是否适应执行过程、环境怎样.en: Long-term tasks accumulate errors. Here, we study whether the current understanding is consistent, whether training adapts to the execution process, how the environment rolls back, and where the first error occurs.

Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon A.zh: 超越记忆：利用明确信念状态的长远代理
Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon A.en: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States

PoS 将“发生过什么”的历史，转成“现在认为世界是什么样、还有什么没完成”的显.zh: PoS 将“发生过什么”的历史，转成“现在认为世界是什么样、还有什么没完成”的显式 belief state（当前判断状态）。
PoS 将“发生过什么”的历史，转成“现在认为世界是什么样、还有什么没完成”的显.en: PoS converts the history of "what has happened" into an explicit belief state of "what is considered to be the world now and what has not yet been completed" (current judgment state).

用实体、属性、关系描述当前世界，再列出未解决需求。例如任务要求“把热杯子放进柜子.zh: 用实体、属性、关系描述当前世界，再列出未解决需求。例如任务要求“把热杯子放进柜子”，状态中不仅要有杯子位置，还要有是否加热。
用实体、属性、关系描述当前世界，再列出未解决需求。例如任务要求“把热杯子放进柜子.en: Describe the current world using entities, attributes, and relations, and then list unresolved requirements. For example, if a task requires "put a hot cup into the cabinet," the state should include not only the cup's location but also whether it is heated.

Belief Sentinel 将当前判断与新工具观察比较，也检查状态内部是否矛.zh: Belief Sentinel 将当前判断与新工具观察比较，也检查状态内部是否矛盾。
Belief Sentinel 将当前判断与新工具观察比较，也检查状态内部是否矛.en: The Belief Sentinel compares the current judgment with new tool observations and also checks whether the internal state is contradictory.

即使动作合法，也要看未完成要求是否减少；反复查看同一柜子而没有加热杯子，就可能陷.zh: 即使动作合法，也要看未完成要求是否减少；反复查看同一柜子而没有加热杯子，就可能陷入 Belief Trapping（判断和行动停滞）。
即使动作合法，也要看未完成要求是否减少；反复查看同一柜子而没有加热杯子，就可能陷.en: Even if an action is legal, it is necessary to see whether unmet requirements are reduced; repeatedly checking the same cabinet without a heated cup could lead to Belief Trapping (stagnation in judgment and action).

根据停滞与未解决需求，重新寻找证据或调整后续行动，再更新状态。.zh: 根据停滞与未解决需求，重新寻找证据或调整后续行动，再更新状态。
根据停滞与未解决需求，重新寻找证据或调整后续行动，再更新状态。.en: Based on stagnation and unresolved needs, it re-seeks evidence or adjusts subsequent actions, then updates the state.

这里的额外状态是提供给 Agent 的决策上下文，不是修改模型权重，也不是自动保.zh: 这里的额外状态是提供给 Agent 的决策上下文，不是修改模型权重，也不是自动保存整个操作系统。
这里的额外状态是提供给 Agent 的决策上下文，不是修改模型权重，也不是自动保.en: The extra state here provides decision context for the Agent; it does not modify model weights, nor does it automatically save the entire operating system.

历史完整与当前判断正确是两件事，后者需要持续更新和检查。.zh: 历史完整与当前判断正确是两件事，后者需要持续更新和检查。
历史完整与当前判断正确是两件事，后者需要持续更新和检查。.en: Complete history and correct current judgment are two different things; the latter requires continuous updating and checking.

合法动作也可能没有任务进展，终止和恢复需要参考目标是否真正被满足。.zh: 合法动作也可能没有任务进展，终止和恢复需要参考目标是否真正被满足。
合法动作也可能没有任务进展，终止和恢复需要参考目标是否真正被满足。.en: Even legal actions may not lead to task progress; termination and recovery need to refer to whether the goal is truly achieved.

状态维护与检查会产生额外调用，应理解它带来的可靠性与执行开销取舍。.zh: 状态维护与检查会产生额外调用，应理解它带来的可靠性与执行开销取舍。
状态维护与检查会产生额外调用，应理解它带来的可靠性与执行开销取舍。.en: State maintenance and checks will generate additional calls; it is important to understand the trade-off between the reliability they bring and the execution overhead.

可以把任务要求变成可检查的状态条件。与 Scout 的错误定位、AgentRew.zh: 可以把任务要求变成可检查的状态条件。与 Scout 的错误定位、AgentRewind 的环境回退结合思考，分别解决判断、检测和执行恢复。
可以把任务要求变成可检查的状态条件。与 Scout 的错误定位、AgentRew.en: Task requirements can be turned into checkable state conditions. Think in combination with Scout's error localization and AgentRewind's environment rollback to separately solve judgment, detection, and execution recovery.

Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Train.zh: Glasseek：训练和可信评估深度搜索代理的透明方法
Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Train.en: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents

Glasseek 同时处理数据构造、压缩感知训练和评测泄漏，其中最需要理解的新机.zh: Glasseek 同时处理数据构造、压缩感知训练和评测泄漏，其中最需要理解的新机制是 CM-GSPO。
Glasseek 同时处理数据构造、压缩感知训练和评测泄漏，其中最需要理解的新机.en: Glasseek handles data construction, compressed sensing training, and evaluation leakage simultaneously, and the new mechanism that needs to be understood most is CM-GSPO.

Agent 生成一段执行轨迹后，把旧历史换成摘要；后面的动作实际上是在“摘要 +.zh: Agent 生成一段执行轨迹后，把旧历史换成摘要；后面的动作实际上是在“摘要 + 新观察”的条件下产生的。如果训练时又假装这些动作看到了完整原历史，计算的概率就不对应当时的决策条件。
Agent 生成一段执行轨迹后，把旧历史换成摘要；后面的动作实际上是在“摘要 +.en: After the Agent generates an execution trajectory, replace the old history with a summary; subsequent actions are actually generated under the condition of "summary + new observations." If during training it is pretended that these actions saw the full original history, the calculated probabilities do not correspond to the decision conditions at the time.

一条任务轨迹切成多个执行子轨迹，并记录每段真正看到的上下文。.zh: 一条任务轨迹切成多个执行子轨迹，并记录每段真正看到的上下文。
一条任务轨迹切成多个执行子轨迹，并记录每段真正看到的上下文。.en: A task trajectory is split into multiple execution sub-trajectories, and the actual context seen for each segment is recorded.

在相同条件下比较策略。.zh: 在相同条件下比较策略。
在相同条件下比较策略。.en: Compare strategies under the same conditions.

计算新旧策略的执行 token 概率时，都使用记录下来的实际上下文，不重新生成另.zh: 计算新旧策略的执行 token 概率时，都使用记录下来的实际上下文，不重新生成另一份摘要。
计算新旧策略的执行 token 概率时，都使用记录下来的实际上下文，不重新生成另.en: When calculating the execution token probabilities of new and old policies, the recorded actual context is used, without regenerating another summary.

所有片段仍属于同一个任务、共享最终奖励。按片段有效长度占整条轨迹的比例调整权重，.zh: 所有片段仍属于同一个任务、共享最终奖励。按片段有效长度占整条轨迹的比例调整权重，避免仅因为一条轨迹被切成更多段，就在训练中获得额外总权重。
所有片段仍属于同一个任务、共享最终奖励。按片段有效长度占整条轨迹的比例调整权重，.en: All segments still belong to the same task and share the final reward. Adjust weights according to the proportion of each segment's effective length to the total trajectory to avoid gaining extra total weight in training just because a trajectory was split into more segments.

提示词、工具观察和摘要生成 token 不进入该执行策略目标；已生成的摘要作为条.zh: 提示词、工具观察和摘要生成 token 不进入该执行策略目标；已生成的摘要作为条件输入保留。搜索与摘要可以共享模型，但不代表摘要 token 也被这个目标直接训练。
提示词、工具观察和摘要生成 token 不进入该执行策略目标；已生成的摘要作为条.en: Prompt tokens, tool observations, and summary generation tokens do not count toward this execution strategy objective; the generated summary is retained as conditional input. Search and summary can share the model, but this does not mean that summary tokens are directly trained for this objective.

评测时，另用搜索和网页访问规则过滤测试集答案、镜像数据等泄漏来源，减少“搜到参考.zh: 评测时，另用搜索和网页访问规则过滤测试集答案、镜像数据等泄漏来源，减少“搜到参考答案”对能力分数的污染。
评测时，另用搜索和网页访问规则过滤测试集答案、镜像数据等泄漏来源，减少“搜到参考.en: During evaluation, use separate search and web access rules to filter test set answers, mirrored data, and other sources of leakage to reduce the contamination of ability scores by "finding reference answers".

上下文管理会改变动作生成的条件，训练必须保留这种真实条件。.zh: 上下文管理会改变动作生成的条件，训练必须保留这种真实条件。
上下文管理会改变动作生成的条件，训练必须保留这种真实条件。.en: Context management changes the conditions for action generation, and training must preserve these actual conditions.

一条轨迹怎样分段、怎样合并损失，会改变学习权重，是算法的一部分。.zh: 一条轨迹怎样分段、怎样合并损失，会改变学习权重，是算法的一部分。
一条轨迹怎样分段、怎样合并损失，会改变学习权重，是算法的一部分。.en: How a trajectory is segmented and how losses are combined will change learning weights; this is part of the algorithm.

搜索能力评测要区分正常证据获取与直接获得基准答案。.zh: 搜索能力评测要区分正常证据获取与直接获得基准答案。
搜索能力评测要区分正常证据获取与直接获得基准答案。.en: Search capability evaluation should distinguish between normal evidence acquisition and directly obtaining benchmark answers.

理解一个 Agent 系统时，要把训练与推理连接起来。推理侧新增压缩、恢复或其他.zh: 理解一个 Agent 系统时，要把训练与推理连接起来。推理侧新增压缩、恢复或其他状态操作后，应检查训练概率和奖励分配是否仍然对应真实执行。
理解一个 Agent 系统时，要把训练与推理连接起来。推理侧新增压缩、恢复或其他.en: When understanding an Agent system, connect training and inference. After adding compression, recovery, or other state operations on the inference side, check whether training probabilities and reward allocations still correspond to actual execution.

AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for L.zh: AgentRewind：针对长时间范围 LLM 代理的可恢复执行
AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for L.en: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

AgentRewind 为长程 Agent 提供可恢复执行：在同一检查点同时记录.zh: AgentRewind 为长程 Agent 提供可恢复执行：在同一检查点同时记录模型上下文与受控工作区，出错后两者一起退回。
AgentRewind 为长程 Agent 提供可恢复执行：在同一检查点同时记录.en: AgentRewind provides recoverable execution for long-range Agents: it records both the model context and controlled workspace at the same checkpoint, and both are rolled back together in case of errors.

记录交互日志，以及与各步骤对应的文件状态变化，形成可定位的检查点。.zh: 记录交互日志，以及与各步骤对应的文件状态变化，形成可定位的检查点。
记录交互日志，以及与各步骤对应的文件状态变化，形成可定位的检查点。.en: Record interaction logs and the file state changes corresponding to each step to form locatable checkpoints.

当 Agent 判断当前路径难以继续时，选择一个此前的位置。.zh: 当 Agent 判断当前路径难以继续时，选择一个此前的位置。
当 Agent 判断当前路径难以继续时，选择一个此前的位置。.en: When the Agent judges that the current path is difficult to continue, it chooses a previous position.

提炼这次失败得到的经验，形成 rewind memory，避免恢复后盲目重复同一.zh: 提炼这次失败得到的经验，形成 rewind memory，避免恢复后盲目重复同一路径。
提炼这次失败得到的经验，形成 rewind memory，避免恢复后盲目重复同一.en: Refine the lessons learned from this failure to form a rewind memory, avoiding blindly repeating the same path after recovery.

恢复那个位置的上下文和工作区；此前已记录的模型输出、工具结果从日志读取，不重新触.zh: 恢复那个位置的上下文和工作区；此前已记录的模型输出、工具结果从日志读取，不重新触发旧工具调用。
恢复那个位置的上下文和工作区；此前已记录的模型输出、工具结果从日志读取，不重新触.en: Restore the context and workspace at that position; previously recorded model outputs and tool results are read from logs, without re-triggering old tool calls.

在恢复状态上加入失败经验，生成新的执行分支。.zh: 在恢复状态上加入失败经验，生成新的执行分支。
在恢复状态上加入失败经验，生成新的执行分支。.en: Add failed experiences to the restored state to generate new execution branches.

例如，Agent 改坏配置文件后，只删除聊天中的错误步骤，会留下坏文件；只恢复文.zh: 例如，Agent 改坏配置文件后，只删除聊天中的错误步骤，会留下坏文件；只恢复文件而保留“配置已经修改成功”的判断，也会不一致。对齐恢复正是这项技术的中心。
例如，Agent 改坏配置文件后，只删除聊天中的错误步骤，会留下坏文件；只恢复文.en: For example, if the Agent corrupts a configuration file, just deleting the erroneous steps in the chat will leave a bad file; just restoring the file while keeping the judgment that 'the configuration has been successfully modified' will also be inconsistent. Alignment recovery is exactly the core of this technology.

错误会同时改变模型看到的记录与外部环境，恢复需要明确覆盖哪些状态。.zh: 错误会同时改变模型看到的记录与外部环境，恢复需要明确覆盖哪些状态。
错误会同时改变模型看到的记录与外部环境，恢复需要明确覆盖哪些状态。.en: Errors simultaneously alter both the records seen by the model and the external environment; recovery requires explicitly specifying which states to overwrite.

失败经验可以保留，失败造成的工作区修改可以回退，两者承担不同作用。.zh: 失败经验可以保留，失败造成的工作区修改可以回退，两者承担不同作用。
失败经验可以保留，失败造成的工作区修改可以回退，两者承担不同作用。.en: Failed experiences can be retained, and workspace modifications caused by failures can be rolled back; the two serve different purposes.

受控文件恢复不等于能撤销网络请求、外部服务或任意进程副作用。.zh: 受控文件恢复不等于能撤销网络请求、外部服务或任意进程副作用。
受控文件恢复不等于能撤销网络请求、外部服务或任意进程副作用。.en: Controlled file recovery does not equate to being able to undo network requests, external services, or arbitrary process side effects.

检查点不是一份聊天备份，而是 Agent 和环境的共同恢复点。与 Scout 连.zh: 检查点不是一份聊天备份，而是 Agent 和环境的共同恢复点。与 Scout 连接时，错误检测信号还要转成合适的回退位置。
检查点不是一份聊天备份，而是 Agent 和环境的共同恢复点。与 Scout 连.en: A checkpoint is not a chat backup, but a joint recovery point for the Agent and the environment. When connecting with Scout, error detection signals also need to be converted into appropriate rollback positions.

Locating Hidden Failures Makes Long-Hori.zh: 定位隐藏故障使长远代理更可靠
Locating Hidden Failures Makes Long-Hori.en: Locating Hidden Failures Makes Long-Horizon Agents More Reliable

Traverse 和 Scout 将一个只有最终成败的任务，变成可以研究逐步错误.zh: Traverse 和 Scout 将一个只有最终成败的任务，变成可以研究逐步错误的过程。
Traverse 和 Scout 将一个只有最终成败的任务，变成可以研究逐步错误.en: Traverse and Scout turn a task that only has a final outcome into a process where step-by-step errors can be studied.

人工检查真实执行轨迹，判断是否出现错误，并标出第一次错误的位置。这样可以区分“最.zh: 人工检查真实执行轨迹，判断是否出现错误，并标出第一次错误的位置。这样可以区分“最后没完成”和“从哪一步开始偏离”。
人工检查真实执行轨迹，判断是否出现错误，并标出第一次错误的位置。这样可以区分“最.en: Manually check the actual execution trajectory, determine whether an error occurred, and mark the location of the first error. This way, one can distinguish between 'finally not completed' and 'diverged from which step'.

以 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 为基础，先通过监督微调学习这些.zh: 以 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 为基础，先通过监督微调学习这些逐步标注，再用强化学习进一步优化错误定位。
以 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 为基础，先通过监督微调学习这些.en: Based on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, first learn these step-by-step annotations through supervised fine-tuning, then further optimize error localization using reinforcement learning.

测试时用于候选选择。.en: Used for candidate selection during testing.

当任务模型生成多条候选执行轨迹时，让 Scout 检查它们，再选择较可靠的结果。.zh: 当任务模型生成多条候选执行轨迹时，让 Scout 检查它们，再选择较可靠的结果。任务模型本身不必重新训练。
当任务模型生成多条候选执行轨迹时，让 Scout 检查它们，再选择较可靠的结果。.en: When the task model generates multiple candidate execution trajectories, let Scout check them and then select the more reliable result. The task model itself does not need to be retrained.

例如，最终测试失败可能是后面多次错误的共同结果；定位最早那次错误，才有可能确定哪.zh: 例如，最终测试失败可能是后面多次错误的共同结果；定位最早那次错误，才有可能确定哪些后续步骤已经建立在错误前提上。这个位置也可成为后续研究恢复策略的输入。
例如，最终测试失败可能是后面多次错误的共同结果；定位最早那次错误，才有可能确定哪.en: For example, the final test failure may result from multiple errors later on; identifying the earliest error is the only way to determine which subsequent steps were based on incorrect premises. This point can also serve as input for future research on recovery strategies.

通用模型会评价答案，不代表它能准确定位长执行过程的第一次错误。.zh: 通用模型会评价答案，不代表它能准确定位长执行过程的第一次错误。
通用模型会评价答案，不代表它能准确定位长执行过程的第一次错误。.en: A general model can evaluate answers, but it does not mean it can accurately pinpoint the first error in a long execution process.

更细的过程标注，为专门验证器提供了不同于最终奖励的学习信号。.zh: 更细的过程标注，为专门验证器提供了不同于最终奖励的学习信号。
更细的过程标注，为专门验证器提供了不同于最终奖励的学习信号。.en: Finer-grained process annotations provide a learning signal to specialized validators that is different from the final reward.

论文中的候选选择与实时检测、自动回滚是不同使用方式；后两者还需要新的执行机制。.zh: 论文中的候选选择与实时检测、自动回滚是不同使用方式；后两者还需要新的执行机制。
论文中的候选选择与实时检测、自动回滚是不同使用方式；后两者还需要新的执行机制。.en: Candidate selection in the paper is a different usage from real-time detection and automatic rollback; the latter two also require new execution mechanisms.

从“给最终结果打分”转向“提供可行动的错误位置”。与 AgentRewind 联.zh: 从“给最终结果打分”转向“提供可行动的错误位置”。与 AgentRewind 联合思考时，要判断定位信息怎样真正减少重做。
从“给最终结果打分”转向“提供可行动的错误位置”。与 AgentRewind 联.en: Shift from "scoring the final result" to "providing actionable error locations." When considering in conjunction with AgentRewind, it is necessary to determine how the localization information can truly reduce rework.

单用户型指主要研究一个用户任务内部的能力或效率；多用户型指多个独立会话/程序共享.zh: 单用户型指主要研究一个用户任务内部的能力或效率；多用户型指多个独立会话/程序共享推理资源的服务设置，实验可能用合成请求或回放代替真人；兼有指同时包含两类设置。多 Agent、多个候选或 batch 本身不构成多用户证据，无法判定的保留“未明确”。这列描述研究设置，不声称论文报告了真实用户人数。
单用户型指主要研究一个用户任务内部的能力或效率；多用户型指多个独立会话/程序共享.en: Single-user type refers to primarily studying the capability or efficiency within a single user task; multi-user type refers to a service setup where multiple independent sessions/programs share inference resources, and experiments may use synthetic requests or replays instead of real users; both refers to setups containing both types simultaneously. Multiple agents, multiple candidates, or batches do not themselves constitute evidence of multi-user use; if undeterminable, retain 'not specified'. This column describes the research setup and does not claim that the paper reports the actual number of users.

单轮/短程与持续多步反馈的长程任务分开；一次请求可以有很长输入。跨会话记忆与长程.en: Separate single-turn/short-term and continuous multi-step long-term tasks; a single request can have very long input. Cross-session memory and long-term execution are also separately labeled. Include 'both' for short tasks and long-term sub-experiments; do not force a binary choice.

延迟区分 TTFT（首 token 等待）、生成耗时和任务完成时间；吞吐注明 t.zh: 延迟区分 TTFT（首 token 等待）、生成耗时和任务完成时间；吞吐注明 token/s、turn/s、task/s 或 program/s。Acc. 是准确率，pass@1 是一次尝试的通过率，Util 是资源利用率；fidelity 是相对参考输出的一致程度。峰值 token、KV 容量、接受长度和命中率用于解释机制，不自动等于任务加速或质量提高。表中列主要指标，不罗列全部实验数字。
延迟区分 TTFT（首 token 等待）、生成耗时和任务完成时间；吞吐注明 t.en: Latency distinguishes TTFT (time to first token), generation time, and task completion time; throughput notes token/s, turn/s, task/s, or program/s. Acc. is accuracy, pass@1 is success rate on the first attempt, Util is resource utilization; fidelity is the degree of agreement relative to reference output. Peak tokens, KV capacity, accepted length, and hit rate are used to explain mechanisms and do not automatically equal task acceleration or quality improvement. The columns list major metrics, not all experimental figures.

Agent 形态描述任务内部角色，和单/多用户服务设置独立；辅助草稿、摘要或验证.zh: Agent 形态描述任务内部角色，和单/多用户服务设置独立；辅助草稿、摘要或验证模型不自动算协作多 Agent。训练要求指是否需要新的参数训练，使用已发布配套权重仍归为需配套训练，提示词优化和在线转移统计不算梯度训练。“闭环”表示行动影响后续观察，可发生在模拟环境中；“生产轨迹回放”表示数据来自生产，但不是在线生产部署的证明。
Agent 形态描述任务内部角色，和单/多用户服务设置独立；辅助草稿、摘要或验证.en: Agent forms describe internal roles within tasks and are independent of single/multi-user service settings; auxiliary drafts, summaries, or verification models are not automatically considered multi-agent collaboration. Training requirements indicate whether new parameter training is needed; using released supporting weights is still considered requiring supporting training. Prompt optimization and online transfer statistics are not counted as gradient training. 'Closed-loop' means actions affect subsequent observations and can occur in a simulated environment; 'production trajectory replay' means data comes from production but is not proof of online production deployment.
